IEEE 1516.1-2025 Java has no standalone LogicalTimeFactoryFactory equivalent. Java obtains the provider-selected LogicalTimeFactory through RTIambassador.getTimeFactory, which is covered by java-tck.logical-time-factory; provider-independent factory-factory construction and naming are C++ API-specific assertions.

exclusions.scope: C++ HLAlogicalTime and HLAlogicalTimeInterval DataElement wrappers
exclusions.reason: The Java 1516.1-2025 API exposes logical-time values and encoding operations but no HLAlogicalTime or HLAlogicalTimeInterval DataElement wrappers or clone contract. The Java base DataElement contract is covered separately by java-tck.data-element-base-contract.

exclusions.scope: Provider implementation classes and implementation-only state-machine tests
exclusions.reason: The portable Java TCK may change only API/provider JARs, factory name, FOM/MIM inputs, and capability profile. Provider implementation evidence remains in the provider's own compliance lane.

exclusions.scope: Provider-internal transport, persistence, allocator, and authorization implementation details
exclusions.reason: Only behavior observable through hla.rti1516_2025 is portable; implementation-specific evidence remains in the provider's own compliance lane.

exclusions.scope: Per-join report-file allocation, filesystem identity/contents, and report append policy across restore
exclusions.reason: The portable negotiated ownership and save/restore behavior is covered by java-tck.pending-negotiated-ownership-save-restore, and the standard public HLAreportServiceFile value is covered separately by java-tck.federate-mom-report-service-file. Exact paths, distinct files per join, file-set stability, filesystem contents, and append-gating are provider implementation details and are not portable HLA assertions.

exclusions.scope: Connect failure caused by an unusable service-report directory, exception classification, and retry policy
exclusions.reason: The candidate has no direct normative clause mapping. Filesystem failure injection, RTIinternalError classification, fallback policy, and retry after repair are provider-specific behaviors, not portable IEEE 1516.1-2025 TCK assertions.

exclusions.reason: The candidate has no direct normative clause mapping. Filesystem failure injection, exception classification, failed-join rollback/discovery policy, and retry after repair are provider-specific behaviors, not portable IEEE 1516.1-2025 TCK assertions.
